subject: Buying lanes & data boundary kickoff — next steps and questionnaire
messages:
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@orbithealth.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Saunders <tsaunders@orbithealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-07T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: Redwood inference fit?

Hey Aditya —

Thanks again for the demo today. Helpful to see the batching/latency controls and the Dedicated options. A few things we promised on the call: a short list of who needs to be involved from our side (economic, security, legal, procurement) and an initial questionnaire so your team can scope what systems need to be assessed.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm which Orbit systems would be considered "in scope" for your security review (prod inference, dev/test, on-prem connectors, S3 buckets, etc.).
- A short timeline for security review + PoC (we’re targetting end of Q2).
- Any doc or checklist we should fill out for SOC/infra evidence.

Quick note on stakeholders from my side: I’ll be the product sponsor, Tom Saunders (cc) is the security lead, and Lisa Morgan (procurement) will own contracts. We might also loop in our Data Platform lead (Marcus Reed) for the network diagram.

Can you send the intake questionnaire and a proposed kickoff agenda? If possible, include who from your side should join each session.

Thanks —
Eleanor
Product Ops | Orbit Health
attachments: none (will attach Orbit questionnaire in follow-up)

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Tom Saunders <tsaunders@orbithealth.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-07T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood inference fit?

Eleanor —

Great to meet you and Tom. Thanks for the clarity on stakeholders. I’ve attached our current security intake (redwood-security-intake-v0.3.pdf) and a lightweight network diagram template (network-diagram.png) to make the systems-in-scope conversation concrete.

Quick answers to your bullets:
- Systems usually in scope for initial review: production inference endpoints (hosted/dedicated), any customer-triggered data storage (S3/Blob storage), VPC peering endpoints, on-prem connectors (agent-based), and telemetry/log sinks (CloudWatch/Datadog). We’ll confirm specifics once we have your network diagram and questionnaire back.
- Proposed timeline:
  * Intake & diagram (you): 1 week
  * Technical kickoff (security + infra): 1 hour in week 2
  * Evidence collection (both sides): 1–3 weeks depending on access
  * Optional short PoC (if needed): 2–4 weeks afterwards
- Evidence checklist: see page 2–3 of the intake PDF (SOC artifacts, encryption details, retention policy, access controls).

Proposed kickoff agenda (30–45 mins):
1) Introductions & scope confirmation (10m)
2) Systems in scope + network boundaries (10m)
3) Evidence & timeline (10m)
4) Next steps / owners (5–15m)

From our side, Marissa (solutions architect) should join the technical kickoff, and Ben (sales lead) will help with procurement/contract questions. Let me know two possible 30min slots next week and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Aditya
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-security-intake-v0.3.pdf, network-diagram.png

From: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@orbithealth.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Saunders <tsaunders@orbithealth.com>, Lisa Morgan <lmorgan@orbithealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-08T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood inference fit?

Thanks Aditya — this is helpful. Attached is Orbit Health's internal questionnaire (orbit-internal-security-questionnaire.pdf) with our answers to the high-level items you called out. A few clarifications from our side while you review:

- Primary stakeholders:
  * Product sponsor: Eleanor Park (me)
  * Security lead: Tom Saunders (cc)
  * Procurement: Lisa Morgan (cc)
  * Data Platform (network & infra): Marcus Reed <mreed@orbithealth.com>

- Systems we expect to include (initial ask): production inference (hosted), S3 buckets for model artifacts/input logs, VPC peering between Redwood and our prod VPC, and a lightweight on-prem connector to pull customer IDs for enrichment (no PHI in payloads).

- Retention question: we retain logs for 90 days internally; do you have options to shorten token/log retention on dedicated instances? Tom flagged this as a gating item for Prod.

Available times for a kickoff next week:
- Tue 2027-02-09 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2027-02-10 14:00–15:00 PT

We’d prefer Tue morning.

Thanks,
Eleanor
attachments: orbit-internal-security-questionnaire.pdf

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Morgan <lmorgan@orbithealth.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-02-08T12:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Buying lanes & data boundary kickoff — next steps and questionnaire

Lisa —

Great to be in touch. Quick commercial notes so procurement has clarity before the kickoff:
- We can provide a standard MSA + SOW; for Dedicated seats we typically do a 12-month minimum.
- If you need an NDA in advance of sharing more sensitive diagrams, happy to route one (DocuSign template: https://www.docusign.com/templates/NDAXYZ-9876).
- I’ll create a HubSpot deal and attach intake materials so both teams have a single source of truth: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ORBIT-4521

One question for your procurement team: do you require a PO before a technical PoC or is a PoC allowed under a mutual evaluation agreement? If PO required, please share timeline and contact.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Saunders <tsaunders@orbithealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-09T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Buying lanes & data boundary kickoff — next steps and questionnaire

Thanks everyone — Tue 2027-02-09 10:00 PT works for us. I’ll send the calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff and include a short pre-read (one-pager) with the items we plan to review.

Short clarifications before the call (so we can use the time efficiently):
- Retention: on Dedicated we can set token/log retention policies down to 7 days operationally; we’ll document options and tradeoffs in the pre-read.
- Scope confirmation request: please paste (or attach) a simple list of the specific S3 buckets / VPC IDs that you expect to include in scope prior to the kickoff. That will let Marissa and our infra engineer validate network adjacency quickly.
- Evidence handoff: if any SOC artifacts are restricted, flag them in the questionnaire and we’ll arrange a secure share (SFTP or signed NDA + DocuSign).

Agenda for the Tue kickoff (30 mins):
1) Introductions + roles (5m)
2) Confirm systems in scope & network boundaries (10m)
3) Evidence items & retention options (10m)
4) Owner assignments & next steps (5m)

Looking forward to the call. I’ll attach the one-pager + invite shortly.

Best,
Aditya
attachments: redwood-security-intake-v0.3.pdf, one-pager-kickoff.pdf
